subject_summary: Observed matches are limited and specific: a Browser-to-page entry to the Create an account link (P04), a primary-control transition over a local control from Work email to Show password button with Password input in between (P08), a backward local TAB move within the password control cluster from Show password button to Password input (P09), and a consecutive transition from the Sign in button to a separate help area that fits both adjacent cross-region continuation and cross-subgroup movement (P01, P05). No evidence supports wraparound/cyclic behavior, auxiliary-to-auxiliary local progression, field-to-field helper-link progression, or auxiliary-link transitions across workflow controls for the supplied candidates.
